analysis.visual_description: On the bookwheel. The book open on Garnish's stool. At the head of a blank margin, one letter. No digits anywhere beneath it.
On the bookwheel. The same margin. The pen hovers and does not come down. The K stands alone.
On the bookwheel. The book shut, a thumb on the cover. The stable door is open in the background. No figure has been written on the cover.
